title: Superwhisper Pricing: Plans and Costs (2026 Guide)
summary: Superwhisper pricing structures are broken down by subscription tier to help you calculate your total software expenses for the upcoming year.
body_markdown:
## Superwhisper pricing tiers and feature limits


### The Free tier: Local processing basics


For users with compatible Apple Silicon hardware who require basic transcription without recurring costs, the Free tier serves as a foundational entry point. According to the[superwhisper pricing page](https://superwhisper.com/dictation-software) , this tier utilizes standard local models that run entirely on-device.


Without an internet connection or data leaving your machine, you can dictate sensitive documents. While it lacks the high-accuracy "Large" models found in paid tiers, it serves as a functional proof-of-concept for the app’s integration with macOS.


### Superwhisper Pro and Business plan pricing


Stepping up to the paid tiers includes professional-grade accuracy and specialized features like custom vocabularies, which stop the AI from misspelling niche industry jargon or client names. The following table breaks down the investment required to move beyond basic local dictation into high-accuracy professional use.


Tier Monthly Price Annual Price Lifetime Price Language Support Processing Type


**Free** $0.00 $0.00 N/A 100+ 100% Local


**Pro** $8.49 $84.99 $249.99 100+ Local & Cloud


*Prices and plan limits checked against[superwhisper.com](https://superwhisper.com/dictation-software) on November 13, 2026.*


When billed annually, the Pro tier starts at $8.49 per month and is the primary choice for you if you need the "Large" model for near-perfect accuracy.


Business tiers cater to teams requiring centralized billing and shared custom vocabularies. This ensures that every employee's dictation remains consistent with company branding.


### One-time purchase vs. subscription models


The $249.99 lifetime license is the most significant differentiator for superwhisper, which means users avoid the recurring burden of subscription fees. This removes the "subscription fatigue" common in AI tooling.

For operations leads who prefer to capitalize software costs upfront rather than managing ongoing monthly overhead, this "pay once" model is attractive.


### Price adjustments for long-term support


The recent adjustment of the lifetime license from $199.00 to $249.00 reflects the increasing complexity of maintaining local model compatibility with evolving macOS versions, which means the price hike directly funds the ongoing technical labor required for software longevity.


This price point ensures that the developers can continue to optimize the software for the latest Apple Silicon iterations without relying on monthly recurring revenue.


For users who locked in the earlier rate, the value proposition remains high, but new adopters must weigh the $249.00 cost against their expected years of use, so a longer commitment is now required to justify the initial investment.


This upfront investment secures permanent access to the "Large" and "Ultra" models, which would otherwise cost hundreds of dollars in API credits over a professional career.


If you are integrating dictation into larger automated workflows via[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) , the MIT-licensed core ensures that the orchestration layer of your stack remains as open and predictable as the local hardware it manages.


Every integration in Activepieces is exposed as a tool schema on its per-project MCP server, allowing an agent to call a registered piece as easily as a flow step.


By checking the Integrations Framework and MCP Server documentation in the open source repo, you can see how this mechanism lets Claude or ChatGPT reach your local dictation data without a second migration.


However, the value of this one-time fee depends on your hardware. The software only justifies its cost if the Mac it runs on has enough unified memory to handle the Pro-tier models without lag.
